security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.longDescription: A cross-platform desktop workbench for the sparq RDF + SPARQL engine. Reuses the sparq web frontend in a native webview and links the engine directly as native Rust (full native store, not the WASM read-replica). MVP scaffold.
